note: Trigger-routing suite, minted alongside make-artifact 2026-08-17 (closes #619, LLD-0011). Positives are BUILD asks — turn/rebuild/render/regenerate an artifact/report page from a design system. Negatives fence the four siblings this capability overlaps trigger vocabulary with: artifact-rules (a standards question with no build ask), make-design-system (authoring/grading the token SOURCE), make-doc (drafting a functional document), markdown-to-markup (plain markdown rendering, no design-system consumption).

render this with our design system
